entities.name: Gustav Adolf Steengracht von Moyland

entities.summary: Gustav Adolf Steengracht von Moyland was a German diplomat and politician of Dutch descent, who served as Nazi Germany's Secretary of State at the Foreign Office from 1943 to 1945.
